@@U03010@@
and there will be nothing new under the sun. In my worldly wanderings, I’ve run into more than a few synthetic people.

@@U03012@@
(Who has never removed his eyes from the phial.)

@@U03013@@
It’s rising, flashing, swelling! Another moment and it’s done! Great ideas always seem insane at the start; but the time will come when we'll laugh at haphazard chance, and a brain capable of great thinking will have been made by a thinking man!

@@U03014@@
(Rapturously observing the phial.)

@@U03015@@
The glass rings out with a grand harmonious power! More opaque now, now more clear. It will come now, it must come! Look! You see? Inside! A tiny shape! A charming little man! Gesturing! What more can we want, what more can the world want? The secret is out. In the bright light of day. Listen— listen to the sound— it's—it’s becoming a voice— oF it’s speaking—

@@U03017@@
(To 瓦格纳 from inside the phial.)

@@U03018@@
So, little father, how about that! That was no joke, believe me! Come on, give me a hug, but careful you don’t crack my glass, not too tight. That’s the way it is. Not all of space is big enough for what is natural, whereas the artificial requires containment.
translation:
@@U03010@@
日光之下并无新事。在我的世俗漫游中，我遇到过不少合成人。

@@U03012@@
（他的眼睛从未离开过小瓶。）

@@U03013@@
它在上升、闪烁、膨胀！再过一会儿就完成了！伟大的想法一开始总是显得疯狂；但总有一天，我们会嘲笑偶然的机会，一个能够进行伟大思考的大脑将由一个有思想的人创造出来！

@@U03014@@
（兴高采烈地观察小瓶。）

@@U03015@@
玻璃发出巨大和谐的力量！现在更不透明，现在更清晰。现在该来了，该来了！看！你看？里面！一个小小的形状！一个迷人的小男人！打手势！我们还想要什么，世界还想要什么？秘密已经泄露了。在白天明亮的光线下。听——听声音——它——它正在变成一种声音——它在说话——

@@U03017@@
（从药瓶里对瓦格纳说。）

@@U03018@@
那么，小爸爸，怎么样？这不是开玩笑，相信我！来吧，拥抱我，但小心别把我的玻璃打碎，不要太紧。就是这样。并不是所有的空间都足够大来容纳自然的东西，而人造的空间则需要遏制。
